note: Cooked food (Items refill 11): a roast keeps for cooked_life_mult times what the raw item had left (Tyler: 1.5 to 2.5 times, 3 at most), never more than the roast's own shelf life (spoilage.json), and a hot meal or drink adds the warms points to body warmth when eaten. raw_sick: eating these uncooked still feeds you but makes you sick for that many game hours (by item id or id suffix; raw meat 24, fiddleheads and beans 12, acorns and wild mushrooms a mild 6). Cooking placeholder (until the cook and food systems exist): at a lit fire, one raw forage item becomes Roasted forage (cooks_into maps others). A gathered item cooks when its id ends with one of the cookable words.
fuel_note: Burn times in GAME seconds (clock is 24:1): a stick 2 game minutes, driftwood 15, firewood 30, a log 2 game hours. A placed campfire starts lit with 20 sticks of fuel.
